meta.note: Colour values, shadow-lift and font stacks are synced from style.css by design-system-apple/build.py; other values are copied from its component rules.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (iOS systemGroupedBackground). Everything sits on it; never put text straight on it except section headers, footers and the hero subtitle.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Grouped list cards, notices, the progress and done cards, file rows (iOS secondarySystemGroupedBackground).

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text and row labels on `surface`, `bg`, `sheet-bg` and `sheet-group` (21:1 light, 17.9:1 dark on `surface`).

tokens.name: label-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: section headers and footers, row values, subtitles, stats labels. 5.1:1 on `surface` and 4.5:1 on `bg` in light; 5.9:1 on `surface`, 4.9:1 on `sheet-group` in dark. Apple's own iOS grey (3.4:1) is replaced on purpose.

tokens.name: label-3
tokens.usage: Glyph hints only: chevrons, the remove × and drag handle at rest, the scan placeholder. Never text. 2.2:1 light / 2.5:1 dark on `surface`: below 3:1 for controls that carry meaning (kept from the source; the buttons have labels and turn `label-2` on hover).

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines (0.5px) between rows, under the frosted bar, around lifted rows; inset to the label's leading edge.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: The 0.5px outline that keeps white cards from dissolving into `bg` (`shadow-edge`).

tokens.name: fill-3
tokens.usage: Segmented control track, progress bar track, disabled filled buttons, pressed nav buttons.

tokens.name: fill-4
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows and buttons, stat tiles, file thumbnails' empty state.

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Row background while pressed (no transition in, a soft one out).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Filled buttons, the progress fill, order badges, focus ring, drop target border. White text on it is 4.7:1. As a focus ring: 4.2:1 on `bg`, 3.6:1 on dark `surface`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Blue text and glyphs: nav buttons, plain and tinted buttons, action rows, checkmarks, download arrows. 5.6:1 on `surface` light, 5.6:1 on dark `surface`, 4.6:1 on dark `sheet-group`.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted (secondary) button fill and the drop zone icon well; `link` text on it. Dark, inside a sheet (`sheet-group`), `link` on it is 3.7:1: below 4.5:1 at 15px (kept from the source).

tokens.name: accent-tint-2
tokens.usage: Drop zone background while files are dragged over it.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Switch on-track and the done check disc. A fill, never text (use `green-text`).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Success text and glyphs: "Ready", the ok status icon, done steps. 5.4:1 on `surface` light, 8.4:1 dark.

tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Warning glyphs and the orange icon tile. In light it is 2.0:1 on `bg`, below 3:1 (kept from the source); the notice text beside it carries the meaning.

tokens.name: red-text
tokens.usage: Error text and the remove × on hover. 5.4:1 on `surface` light, 6.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: switch-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off. On/off is also told by the knob's side, not colour alone.

tokens.name: seg-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected segment's sliding thumb in `SegmentedControl`.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Frosted navigation bar and phone bottom bar, under saturate(180%) blur(20px). Solid `bg` when transparency is reduced.

tokens.name: sheet-bg
tokens.usage: Sheet (dialog) background.

tokens.name: sheet-group
tokens.usage: Grouped lists inside a sheet: one step lighter than `sheet-bg` in dark so groups stay visible.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The page being scanned and picture thumbnails: paper stays white in dark too.

tokens.name: tile-blue
tokens.usage: Row icon tile (engine, update). White glyph 4.0:1 light, 3.7:1 dark.

tokens.name: tile-gray
tokens.usage: Row icon tile (resolution, Markdown file). White glyph 3.3:1.

tokens.name: tile-green
tokens.usage: Row icon tile (languages, tables). White glyph 2.2:1: decorative, the row label carries the meaning (kept from the source).

tokens.name: tile-indigo
tokens.usage: Row icon tile (table pictures option). White glyph 5.7:1.

tokens.name: tile-orange
tokens.usage: Row icon tile (headers and footers option). White glyph 2.2:1: decorative (kept from the source).

tokens.name: tile-red
tokens.usage: Row icon tile (searchable PDF). White glyph 3.6:1.

families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Arabic", Tahoma, Arial, sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI Variable Display", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: The page's large title in the hero; 30px on phones. Folds into `nav-title` on scroll.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: The app name in the About sheet.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: The progress card's title; 18px on phones.

styles.name: nav-title
styles.usage: Collapsed navigation bar title and sheet titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row labels, values and body copy. Arabic: line height 1.55, no tracking.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Large buttons and the drop zone title.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: File names in the file list.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.sample: Works fully offline: your files never leave this computer.
styles.usage: Hero subtitle, done subtitle, notices, empty notes, drop zone hint.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Section footers, row subtitles, file meta, progress meta.

styles.name: section-header
styles.usage: Section headers, uppercase. Arabic: 14px, no uppercase.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Stat tile numbers, tabular figures, counted up by a spring.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, row and section-header side padding, sheet body padding.

tokens.name: space-row-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's tile, label and value; thumbnails gap.

tokens.name: space-row-y
tokens.usage: A row's vertical padding (min height 52px).

tokens.name: space-header
tokens.usage: Section header to its group.

tokens.name: space-footer
tokens.usage: Group to its section footer.

tokens.name: space-group
tokens.usage: Between consecutive groups in a section or sheet.

tokens.name: space-start
tokens.usage: Above the main button.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Between sections.

tokens.name: inset-separator
tokens.usage: Row separator inset: gutter 16 + tile 28 + gap 12, so hairlines start at the label.

tokens.name: inset-separator-file
tokens.usage: File list separator inset: gutter 16 + thumbnail 44 + gap 12.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Centred sheets; phone bottom sheets use 14px on the top corners.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Small buttons (34px tall); nav buttons use 18px on 36px.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: Grouped lists, notices, large buttons, phone bottom bar button.

tokens.name: radius-lifted
tokens.usage: A dragged (lifted) file row, the drop zone, stat tiles.

tokens.name: radius-segmented
tokens.usage: Segmented control track; thumbnails (10px).

tokens.name: radius-segment
tokens.usage: The segmented control's thumb and segments; scan paper.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: 28px row icon tiles (25%).

tokens.name: radius-thumb
tokens.usage: 44×50 file thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: The 6px progress bar.

tokens.name: radius-app-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon squircle at any size.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A file row while dragged (with a 0.5px `separator` ring).

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: Every group and the app icon: an `edge` hairline instead of a border.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: The switch knob.

tokens.name: shadow-thumb
tokens.usage: The segmented control's thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Centred sheets (with a 0.5px `separator` ring).

tokens.name: shadow-icon
tokens.usage: The app icon in the hero and About sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: The page being scanned in the progress card.

size.note: Fixed sizes of controls, from the component rules.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Minimum row height; large buttons.

tokens.name: size-navbar
tokens.usage: Navigation bar height (plus the top safe area).

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Row icon tiles (18px glyph, stroke 2).

tokens.name: size-nav-button
tokens.usage: Nav bar icon buttons (21px glyph).

tokens.name: size-icon-button
tokens.usage: Remove and drag-handle buttons (18px glyph): the touch target.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Small buttons and segments.

tokens.name: size-switch-w
tokens.usage: Switch width (31px tall, 27px knob).

tokens.name: size-app-icon
tokens.usage: Hero app icon; 54px on phones, 72px in About.

tokens.name: width-content
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page column and the nav bar content.

tokens.name: width-sheet
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a centred sheet.

tokens.name: z-lifted
tokens.usage: A dragged row above its neighbours.

tokens.name: z-navbar
tokens.usage: The sticky navigation bar.

tokens.name: z-mobile-bar
tokens.usage: The phone bottom bar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: The sheet layer and its scrim.
